types.label: Appointment / Service
types.summary: A person chooses a service, date and time for a one-to-one or scheduled appointment.

types.label: Venue / Resource
types.summary: A room, hall or shared resource is requested for a defined start and end time, with clash checking.
types.bestFor: Community spaces, venues, facilities and shared resources

types.label: Group / Visit
types.summary: A group requests a visit or organised activity that needs staff review before it can be confirmed.
types.bestFor: Visitor attractions, charities, education and community organisations

types.label: Recurring Booking
types.summary: A repeated activity requests the same resource and time pattern across a bounded series of dates.
types.bestFor: Classes, clubs, regular room users and recurring activities
